Ian and Matt are Tennis Australia Master Club professionals with decades of experience in coaching, education and talent development, making them leaders in the field of tennis performance. Ian brings over 30 years of coaching experience in Australia and the UK as both a Tennis Australia Master Club professional and an LTA performance coach. Renowned for his work in talent development, Ian has guided players to national success including junior champions and State League winners. He's also a coach education facilitator and advisors for Tennis Australia, contributing to national programs and pathways to support players and coach development. Matt combines 15 years of full-time coaching with a master's degree in psychology, giving him a unique perspective on performance and skill development. His coaching career spans private coaching and workforce development initiatives in both the UK and Australia. Matt has written and developed educational resources for coaches and PE teachers with work published by the ITF and actively contributes to coach education for Tennis Australia. Together Matt and Ian present peak performing, sharing their innovative approaches to coaching and performance development to inspire coaches and players alike.
